program='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(len(grid[i])):
            if grid[i][j] != 2:
                continue
            orbit = (
                (i, j), (j, i), (n - 1 - i, n - 1 - j),
                (n - 1 - j, n - 1 - i), (i, n - 1 - j),
                (n - 1 - i, j), (j, n - 1 - i), (n - 1 - j, i),
            )
            candidates = [grid[r][c] for r, c in orbit if grid[r][c] != 2]
            if not candidates or any(value != candidates[0] for value in candidates):
                raise ValueError("Cannot uniquely recover a masked cell by symmetry")
            out[i][j] = candidates[0]
    return out
'''
